basis: Fit-first assessment from human-provided Travelpayouts Available-program screenshots. Commission is secondary to visitor utility and ERN editorial fit.

firstActivationSet.name: Klook
firstActivationSet.reason: Broad global destination activities and transport; natural Things to do placement; useful alternative/complement to Viator.

firstActivationSet.name: Tiqets
firstActivationSet.reason: Strong attraction/landmark/museum fit for destination pages and Before You Go; supports city/product-level tools.

firstActivationSet.name: Welcome Pickups
firstActivationSet.reason: Airport and destination transfer utility fills a distinct pre-trip need with less overlap with Viator.

visibleHoldSet.name: Kiwitaxi
visibleHoldSet.reason: Good transfer fit but overlaps Welcome Pickups; keep as alternate until first transfer partner is tested.

visibleHoldSet.name: Localrent.com
visibleHoldSet.reason: Useful car-rental category but adds complexity and is less universal than transfer/activities.

visibleHoldSet.name: Kiwi.com
visibleHoldSet.reason: Flights are useful but less tightly connected to the current-place viewing moment; manual deep-link path is possible but not first-wave priority.

visibleHoldSet.name: Airalo
visibleHoldSet.reason: Useful travel utility, but eSIM is secondary to ERN's core see-place-then-go flow.

visibleHoldSet.name: Yesim
visibleHoldSet.reason: Useful eSIM utility; redundant with Airalo/GigSky, so only one eSIM partner should be considered later.

visibleHoldSet.name: GigSky
visibleHoldSet.reason: Another eSIM option; hold to avoid duplicating utilities.
